instructions:
Documentation task T3 only, root /home/opencode/projects/default/mcp-bridge. Write ONLY docs/runbooks/header-parameters.md (new) and docs/logging-contract.md. No code, tests, tickets, spec or state changes. Read spec R7/AC03-3, ticket 03, the existing logging-contract error-classification table, and internal/observe/envelope.go's runtimeErrorInfo mapping first.

RUNBOOK content requirements: exact headings `## Protocol versions`, `## Mechanism`, `## Failure code and operator action`, `## Cost`. Protocol versions: `2026-07-28` and later carry `Mcp-Param-<name>` headers for parameters annotated `x-mcp-header`; older negotiated versions cannot; a missing InitializeResult is treated as below. Mechanism: stateless mode opens a fresh session per call, checks the header-annotation index and protocol gate, runs one paged `tools/list` definition pass until the target tool page is found inside the single `limits.call_timeout`, then emits one `tools/call` with the unchanged body arguments and the parameter headers; stateful mode reuses the discovery session, applies the same gate/pass, pays zero pass cost when the peer advertises a positive tools/list TTL, and permits one refetch when TTL is zero; body-only tools pay no pass; no extra log record is emitted by a successful pass. Failure code and operator action: `parameter_header_unsupported` with `execution_state=not_started`, payload-free, zero tool executions and zero post-gate list requests; operator must upgrade the upstream or pin/repoint it to negotiate `2026-07-28` or later, or call a body-only tool; repeated records classify as configuration, non-retryable. Cost: one definition pass up to every upstream tools/list page inside the single call timeout, paid on every stateless header call and on stateful zero-TTL misses; raise `limits.call_timeout` for large catalogs; a positive TTL removes the stateful cost. Keep prose factual and concise, no invented fields or metrics.

LOGGING CONTRACT: add `parameter_header_unsupported` to the closed error-classification table exactly as RuntimeErrorInfo emits it: kind `configuration`, retryable `false`, remediation `correct the server configuration or credentials`. Prefer a dedicated row if the existing rows' remediation differs; do not change other rows, codes, fields or event tables.

Verification: six greps must exit 0 — `^## Protocol versions$`, `^## Mechanism$`, `^## Failure code and operator action$`, `^## Cost$` in docs/runbooks/header-parameters.md; `parameter_header_unsupported` in the runbook; and `parameter_header_unsupported` in docs/logging-contract.md. Also run `go test ./cmd/mcp-bridge -run 'TestLoggingContract' -count=1` and report its exit; if a doc-only contract assertion fails, fix the docs, not the test. Report the six grep outcomes and the test output. Do not touch T4 or any other file. No commits.
